agents.description: Specialized agent for adding and managing Azure Event Grid and Service Bus topic subscriptions in Terragrunt infrastructure.

inputs.name: jiraTicket
inputs.description: The Jira ticket number (e.g., DSO-1234) for reference in the PR and commits.

inputs.name: subscriptionType
inputs.description: The type of subscription: 'eventGrid' or 'serviceBus'.

inputs.name: FunctionApplicationName
inputs.description: The target service or Azure Function App hosting the target endpoint. (e.g., commonfxn, compliance). Agent will auto-discover if omitted.

inputs.name: environments
inputs.description: List of environments to target. Defaults to all 10 standard environments (poc is always excluded).

inputs.name: topicName
inputs.description: The name of the topic or  servicebus to subscribe to. Will be normalized by the agent.

inputs.name: functionEndpointNames
inputs.description: One or more function names to create subscriptions for (each gets a separate entry eg. HandleAutoJobSearchAlerts).

inputs.name: eventTypes
inputs.description: Specific Event Grid event types to filter for (e.g., Aya.Core.Events.Job.Created).

inputs.name: subscriptionName
inputs.description: Descriptive name for the subscription resource.

inputs.name: Comment
inputs.description: additional instructions for agents only if needed (e.g., for special handling or edge cases).

agents.description: Specialized agent for adding and managing Azure Storage Account resources (queues, containers/blobs, and tables) in Terragrunt infrastructure.

inputs.name: jiraTicket
inputs.description: The Jira or CR ticket identifier (e.g., BIL-1234) for reference.

inputs.name: resourceType
inputs.description: The type of resource to create: 'queue', 'container', or 'table'.

inputs.name: storageAccountNames
inputs.description: List of specific storage account names to update (e.g., ayadevwussa01).

inputs.name: resourceNames
inputs.description: The name(s) of the queues, containers, or tables to add.

inputs.name: poisonQueue
inputs.description: Boolean or specific name indicating if a '-poison' queue should be created (queues only).

inputs.name: containerAccessType
inputs.description: The access level for containers (defaults to 'private').

inputs.name: Comments
inputs.description: Additional instructions for agents only if needed (e.g., for special handling or edge cases).

agents.description: Create or update Azure Service Bus topic, queue, or subscription in Terragrunt with namespace defaulting and namespace auto-create when missing.

inputs.name: service_type
inputs.description: Type of Service Bus resource to create. topic, queue, subscription

inputs.name: add_subscription
inputs.description: true/false. If true and service_type is topic or queue, also create a subscription to it after the resource is created.

inputs.name: service_name
inputs.description: Name of the topic, queue, or subscription to create.

inputs.name: environments
inputs.description: Optional target environments (example: ["int", "prod"]). If omitted, apply to all environment folders under infrastructure/ayaApplications/ayaIntegrationServices/servicebus.

inputs.name: servicebus_namespace
inputs.description: Optional namespace override. If omitted, default to sbns-${local.alias}-${local.envName}-common-svs-1. If provided but missing, create namespace and matching local namespace id first, then use it.

inputs.name: subscription_parent_type
inputs.description: Parent resource type the subscription attaches to. Optional when add_subscription is true (defaults to service_type). Required when service_type is subscription.

inputs.name: subscription_parent_name
inputs.description: Name of the parent topic or queue. Optional when add_subscription is true (defaults to service_name). Required when service_type is subscription.

inputs.name: sql_filter
inputs.description: Optional SQL filter expression for subscription rules.

inputs.name: correlation_id
inputs.description: Optional correlation id value for correlation filter rules.

inputs.name: jira_ticket
inputs.description: Optional Jira reference (example: DSO-1234 or CR-1234).
